NI.label: Net earnings attributable to Procter & Gamble

Eq.label: Total shareholders' equity (incl. noncontrolling interest)
Eq.statement: Consolidated Balance Sheets / Statements of Shareholders' Equity

step1_pattern.structure: 两年对比：4 个盈利比率 × 2 年 + 文字结论
step1_pattern.operation: 4 个除法；ROE 分母为期初期末平均权益
step1_pattern.output_format: 百分比，保留 1 位小数
notes: GT 未给出任何输入数字，只给比率 → 口径需由回测反推
ROE 口径（反推）：归属 P&G 净利润 ÷ 期初期末平均总股东权益（含少数股东权益）
GT 文字与数字矛盾：毛利率 47.6→51.4 是上升，文字写 "slight decline"；文字称 "ROA and ROE 改善"，但 ROA 未计算、ROE 31.2→30.5 是下降

step2_verdict: SEED_ERROR（部分）。GT 未给输入，回测反推口径后 8 个比率中 7 个精确复现；FY2023 毛利率 GT=47.6，按文件 (82,006−42,760)/82,006 = 47.86% → 47.9。叙述部分与数字矛盾（见 step1）。

step3_plan.target_rule: 最新一期 10-K（FY2026，截至 2026-06-30），比较 FY2026 vs FY2025；ROE 需要 FY2024 期末权益作期初
step3_plan.rationale: 所有数据项在 FY2026 10-K 中可得（见 availability）。去掉无法判分的叙述，改为每个比率的变化方向。

step5_question.question: Using Procter & Gamble's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, analyze P&G's profitability for fiscal 2026 and fiscal 2025 with the following ratios: gross margin = (net sales - cost of products sold) / net sales; operating margin = operating income / net sales; net margin = net earnings attributable to Procter & Gamble / net sales; return on equity (ROE) = net earnings attributable to Procter & Gamble / average total shareholders' equity, where the average is taken over the beginning and end of each fiscal year. Report each ratio for both years as a percentage rounded to one decimal place, and for each ratio state whether it increased, decreased, or was unchanged from fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2026 (compare the rounded values).
changes_vs_seed: 题干写明 4 个比率的公式（含 ROE 用平均权益）
开放式 "analyse" 改为 "数值 + 变化方向"，删除叙述部分

notes: ROE 期初权益（FY2024 年末 50,559）来自股东权益变动表，已核对
NPM FY2025 = 18.95%，接近舍入分界（见 rounding_near_boundary），判分容差 ±0.1 可吸收
